faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Get answers to common questions about Dragify AI and how it can transform your business operations.

items.question: What is Dragify, and how does it work?
items.answer: Dragify is a no-code platform that empowers businesses to build and deploy intelligent AI agents. These agents can automate tasks, interact with users, process data, and integrate with your existing tools—all without writing a single line of code.

items.question: Do I need any technical skills to use Dragify?
items.answer: No. Dragify is built for non-technical users. Its drag-and-drop interface and prebuilt function blocks let anyone—from operations managers to customer support leads—build workflows and intelligent agents with ease.

items.question: What kind of tasks can Dragify's AI agents handle?
items.answer: Dragify agents can manage customer support, automate data entry, process documents (OCR), interact with APIs, summarize emails, generate reports, and even make decisions based on business logic or past interactions.

items.question: Can Dragify integrate with our existing systems (CRM, Slack, Gmail, etc.)?
items.answer: Yes. Dragify includes ready-made integrations for popular tools like Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, WhatsApp, CRMs, databases, and more. You can also connect to custom APIs to extend functionality across your tech stack.

items.question: How is Dragify different from traditional RPA platforms?
items.answer: Dragify goes beyond rule-based automation. It uses Agentic Process Automation (APA)—where AI agents think, plan, and act independently within workflows. It's faster to deploy, more scalable, and offers true decision-making intelligence.

items.question: Is Dragify secure for enterprise use?
items.answer: Absolutely. Dragify offers secure data handling, role-based access control, and options for on-premise deployment. Sensitive workflows can be fully self-hosted to meet strict compliance and security requirements.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Have questions about our pricing or features? Find answers to common questions below.

items.question: How does the pricing work?
items.answer: Our pricing is based on a monthly or annual subscription model. You can choose between our Basic, Professional, or Enterprise plans depending on your needs. Annual subscriptions offer a 20% discount compared to monthly billing. Each plan includes a different number of AI model deployments, API calls, and storage capacity.

items.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
items.answer: Yes, you can upgrade your plan at any time and the change will take effect immediately. If you wish to downgrade, the change will be applied at the end of your current billing cycle. Your account will be prorated accordingly for upgrades.

items.question: What happens if I exceed my plan limits?
items.answer: If you exceed your plan's limits for API calls or storage, you'll be notified and can choose to upgrade to a higher plan or pay for additional usage at our standard overage rates. We never cut off service without warning you first.

items.question: Do you offer a free trial?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial for all our plans. You can try out all the features without any commitment. No credit card is required for the trial period. After the trial ends, you can choose to subscribe to one of our plans.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major credit cards including Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. For Enterprise plans, we also support invoicing and bank transfers. All payments are processed securely through our payment partners.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for annual subscriptions. For monthly subscriptions, you can cancel anytime but we don't provide prorated refunds for partial months. If you have any issues with our service, please contact our support team.

meta.description: Learn how Dragify AI collects, uses, shares, and protects personal information, including billing and payment data.

header.title: Privacy Policy
header.description: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect personal information when you use Dragify AI.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.p1: Dragify AI provides a no-code platform for building and operating AI agents and workflow automations for businesses. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect and process personal information through our website, platform, and related services.
intro.p2: By using our services, you acknowledge this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with it, please do not use our services.

personal.title: Personal Information
personal.p: We collect personal information you provide directly when creating an account, requesting a demo, purchasing a subscription, or contacting support. Depending on your use, this may include:
list: Name and work contact details (email, phone)
Company details (company name, role, business information)
Account credentials and profile details
Billing details (billing address, invoices, tax-related information)
Support communications and submitted requests

usage.title: Usage Data
usage.p: We automatically collect technical and usage data to operate, secure, and improve our services. This may include:
list: IP address
Device, browser, and operating system details
Log data, timestamps, and error/diagnostic events
Pages and features used, session activity, and referring URLs
Cookie and similar tracking identifiers

userContent.title: User Content
userContent.p: When you use Dragify AI, we process content you choose to upload or connect, such as workflow inputs, prompts, files, datasets, and integration data, solely to provide requested services and platform functionality.

use.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
use.p: We use collected information for legitimate business purposes, including:
list: Providing and maintaining the Dragify AI platform and related services
Creating and managing user accounts and subscriptions
Processing billing transactions and sending invoices/receipts
Securing our services, preventing fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access
Providing customer support and responding to inquiries
Improving product performance, features, and reliability
Sending important service, legal, and policy communications
Complying with legal obligations and enforcing our terms

share.title: 4. How We Share Your Information
share.p: We may share your information in the following situations:

list.serviceProviders: With Service Providers: We share information with trusted vendors who help us deliver the service (hosting, analytics, communications, support tools, and payment processing). For card payments, transactions are processed by Paymob and/or approved payment partners. We do not store full card numbers or card CVV data on our servers.
list.businessTransfers: Business Transfers: Information may be transferred as part of a merger, acquisition, financing, reorganization, or sale of assets, subject to applicable confidentiality protections.
list.consent: With Your Consent: We may share information where you explicitly direct or authorize us to do so.
list.legal: Legal Requirements: We may disclose information when required by law, legal process, or to protect rights, safety, and service integrity.

security.title: 5. Security of Your Information
security.p: We use administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards to protect personal information, including access controls, encryption in transit where appropriate, monitoring, and least-privilege practices. No method of transmission or storage is fully secure, but we continuously work to protect your data.

rights.title: 6. Your Data Protection Rights
rights.p: Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights regarding your personal information, including:
list: Access to the personal information we hold about you
Correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal information
Deletion of personal information, subject to legal or contractual obligations
Restriction of or objection to certain processing activities
Data portability where technically feasible and legally required
Withdrawal of consent where processing is based on consent
rights.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at contact@dragify.ai. We may request verification before processing your request.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.p: We use cookies and similar technologies for authentication, security, session continuity, analytics, and product improvement. You can control cookies through your browser settings, but some features may not function properly if cookies are disabled.

transfers.title: 8. International Data Transfers
transfers.p: Your information may be processed in countries other than your country of residence. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards and contractual protections for cross-border transfers in accordance with applicable law.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.p: Our services are designed for businesses and are not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, contact us so we can take appropriate action.

changes.title: 10. Changes to this Privacy Policy
changes.p: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect legal, operational, or product changes. Material updates will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

contact.title: 11. Contact Us
contact.p: If you have privacy, data protection, or billing-related questions, contact us at contact@dragify.ai.

header.title: Refund Policy
header.description: This Refund Policy explains when refunds are available and how refund requests are processed.

intro.title: 1. Overview
intro.p1: Dragify AI provides digital software services, including AI agent automation and workflow subscriptions. This policy applies to payments made for our plans and services.
intro.p2: We aim to keep billing clear and fair. If you believe you were charged incorrectly, contact us and we will review your case promptly.

eligibility.title: 2. When a Refund May Be Approved
eligibility.p: Refund requests may be approved in cases such as:
list: Duplicate or accidental charges for the same order
A technical billing error caused by our system
A first-time annual subscription cancellation requested within 14 days of payment, where service usage is minimal

nonRefundable.title: 3. Non-Refundable Cases
nonRefundable.p: Refunds are generally not provided for:
list: Partial billing periods on monthly plans
Renewal charges when cancellation was not requested before the next billing date
Consumed usage, credits, API calls, or add-on services already delivered
Accounts suspended or terminated due to policy violations, abuse, or fraud

billingErrors.title: 4. Billing Error Corrections
billingErrors.p: If we confirm a billing error, we will correct the charge or issue the appropriate refund to the original payment method.

howToRequest.title: 5. How to Request a Refund
howToRequest.p: To request a refund, contact Sales@Cloudilic.com and include:
list: Account email address
Transaction/order reference
Payment date and charged amount
Reason for the request

timing.title: 6. Review and Processing Times
timing.p: We typically review requests within 3 business days. If approved, refunds are initiated to the original payment method. Final settlement time depends on your bank or card issuer and may take 7-21 business days.

gateway.title: 7. Payment Gateway and Card Refunds
gateway.p: Card payments are processed securely through Paymob and/or approved payment partners. Approved refunds are sent back to the same card or payment source used in the original transaction, according to gateway and regulatory requirements.

chargebacks.title: 8. Chargebacks
chargebacks.p: Before opening a chargeback, please contact us so we can resolve the issue quickly. Fraudulent or abusive chargebacks may result in account restrictions.

cancellations.title: 9. Subscription Cancellation
cancellations.p: You can cancel your subscription at any time. Cancellation stops future renewals but does not retroactively refund completed billing periods unless explicitly approved under this policy.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.p: We may update this Refund Policy from time to time to reflect operational or legal requirements. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.p: For refund and billing questions, contact Sales@Cloudilic.com.
